query_analysis.original_query: In a distillation column, feed flowrate variations are leading to severe temperature disturbances. What control scheme can mitigate this issue effectively?
query_analysis.expanded_query: Identify and recommend an effective control scheme to mitigate severe temperature disturbances in a distillation column caused by feed flowrate variations.

selected_agents.role: Designing effective control schemes to mitigate temperature disturbances
Assisting in modeling and simulation of proposed control schemes

communication_strategy.information_flow: Iterative design and simulation feedback between control strategy development and performance analysis
communication_strategy.collaboration_protocol: Collaborative modeling and validation of control schemes to ensure effectiveness in mitigating temperature disturbances

clarification_questions: What are the specific characteristics of the feed flowrate variations (e.g., magnitude, frequency)?
Is there an existing control system in place? If so, what are its specifications?
Are there any constraints or limitations on implementing new control schemes (e.g., equipment availability, budget)?
